scope: Read only retained durable job metadata to locate the exact already submitted public LAN source-publication key. No process_start, target command, signal or replay.
raw_response_handling: Retain original SDK in private working memory, inspect schema without printing unrelated job metadata, publish only task-related public provenance; no assumption that other jobs contain no private data.
on_error: Preserve error SDK, stop. No fresh process request or alternate key.
on_match: Bind exact host/key/typed command or request digest before querying original job authority.
